### MadaLogo

Official mada bilingual lockup for card payments.

Level: atom

Use when:
- Checkout card options where mada is accepted
- Payment method lists that name mada as the rail

Don't use when:
- Never as decoration or for other rails (Apple Pay, bank transfer)

Accessibility: Alt text «مدى»; prefer 24 px or larger.

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

A faithful vector of the official mada lockup, brought in from the brand asset. Use it only where mada is the payment rail (card / checkout) - never as a generic decorative element.

### Anatomy

Two stacked bars (blue over green) + the bilingual wordmark مدى (Arabic) over mada (Latin). Fixed lockup - don’t rearrange the parts.

### Sizes

Five heights (px): 16 · 24 · 32 · 48 · 64. At the smallest sizes prefer 24+ so the wordmark stays legible. Scale proportionally.

### Tones

Three tones:

- Brand - full colour (blue #259BD6 · green #84B740 · dark #27292D). Default; on light neutral surfaces.
- Mono - bound to text/default; single-colour / print / low-emphasis.
- Inverse - bound to text/inverse (white); on dark surfaces & photography.

### Usage - Do and Don't

Do

Use the full-colour lockup on light surfaces at a DS size.

Do

Use Inverse (white) on dark surfaces or photography.

Don’t

Don’t stretch, distort, or rotate - keep the exact lockup and proportions.

Don’t

Don’t recolour the bars or wordmark - the blue/green are fixed mada brand colours (use Mono/Inverse for single-colour needs).

### Notes from the maintainer

> **Info:** Brought in from the official mada asset and cloned to clean vectors. Brand colours (blue/green/dark) are mada’s own and are intentionally NOT Safqah tokens.

> **Tip:** Mono + Inverse recolour every vector to text/default / text/inverse so they adapt with the theme; only Brand is fixed.

> **Warning:** Third-party payment mark - use it only to indicate mada acceptance, never as a generic icon, and never alter its colours.
